newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE JUNE 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE JUNE 3.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- New Prime Minister Lionel Jospin calls for a morally irreproachable government, rules out personalities facing legal action. Communists call for an increase in minimum wage as a condition to their taking part in government.
-- Renault carmaker European works council meeting this morning over planned shutdown of Belgian assembly plant at Vilvoorde and possible alternative solutions.

-- Mutual insurance companies fend off competition by banking groups, register profits for 1996 thanks to trend toward fewer car accidents, few climate-related disasters and overall good performance of financial markets.
-- Peugeot carmaker unveils restructuring plan involving some 2,800 job cuts.
-- Mutuelles du Mans refuses to take part in bailing out insolvent French overseas territory bank Credit Martiniquais in which they hold an 11.58 percent stake.
